eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Hamilton, TN; at 4:41 AM on SEP 6, 2026 Effective until 8:41 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Missing Juvenile - Ayden Jules 15-year-old. Party is a black male, last seen wearing blue long sleeve shirt with grey sweatpants. Will have blue/white duffel bag, a green backpack, and a black suitcase with him. Party is missing from the Sale Creek area. If juvenile is approached, he may run. If you see him, please call 9-1-1.
